thread:
ravi: kicked off sparse-quant bring-up for rwd-v6-int4-sparse (canary @3%). early numbers look promising: token cost -40%, median latency -22%, but aggregate convo-quality metric down 0.9% and code-complete MRR dipped 2.1%. thoughts on auto-gate thresholds? :chart_with_downwards_trend:
emily: can you paste the per-slice breakdown? I want to see distribution (esp code and long-doc).
ravi: short CSV snippet:
```
slice,queries,conv_quality,baseline_conv,q_delta_abs
conversation-short,11000,0.794,0.792,+0.2%
code-completion,2100,0.618,0.632,-2.1%
longdoc-extract,900,0.499,0.518,-1.9%
faq,3200,0.727,0.731,-0.4%
```

hao: code-completion drop is biggest worry. do we have hallucation/sample-level diffs?
sam: quick check from eval harness: code halluc rate 1.2% -> 2.0% (+0.8pp). longdoc shows more token-level truncation errors on quant model (probable tokenization edgecases).
emily: propose two-tier rule: 1) early-warning: metric z>1.5 on any high-priority slice -> quiet-burn (hold ramp for 2h and increase sampling) 2) auto-soft-fallback: delta_abs >=1.5% weighted on priority over 45m -> steer 50% traffic to fallback and spawn shadow for 6h 3) hard-rollback delta_abs >=3.0% or hallucation increase >0.5pp sustained 30m -> rollback.
ravi: prefer concrete numeric config. draft: 
```
{"gate":{"metric":"conv_quality","soft_delta":0.015,"soft_window_mins":45,"hard_delta":0.03,"hard_window_mins":30,"early_warning_z":1.5,"early_warning_action":"quiet_burn_2h","priority_weights":{"code-completion":2.5,"longdoc-extract":1.8},"min_queries":500}}
```

hao: two adjustments: make hallucation an independent trigger (halluc_delta_pp_soft=0.5, halluc_delta_pp_hard=1.0). and add coldstart smoothing: ignore first 20% of queries per slice for 10m to avoid warming noise.
emily: yes to halluc trigger. also recommend per-customer policy: Dedicated customers get local route to int8 pool + standby spin; Hosted gets progressive steer then region fallback. document in rollout playbook.
sam: ops question: soft action "steer 50%" — do we prefer steering to int8 or to sparse pool? for minimum disruption steer to hybrid-int8 fallback. customers on Dedicated might not have hybrid. need per-customer mapping.
ravi: mapping: Hosted -> steer to rwd-v6-int8-global ; Dedicated -> steer to local int8 pool if available else rollback. add a cooldown of 60m after soft action before allowing another soft action.
ci-bot: smoke run report for rwd-v6-int4-sparse: unit-tests \u2705, load-check \u2705, eval WARN (slices: code-completion, longdoc-extract)
emily: action items: 1) sam add halluc triggers + coldstart ignore to gate config 2) hao run focused shadow on code-completion x6 and increase halluc checks 3) ravi update rollout playbook with Dedicated mapping and cooldown 4) emily open PR with gate JSON and sample thresholds. tagging @ravi for final signoff once shadow results in. :white_check_mark:
ravi: agreed. will review tomorrow after shadow. thanks team :thumbsup:
